model: BSL-EARSM: Wallin-Johansson stress-strain relation in the BSL k-omega model, A1 = 1.245, beta9 = 0

sources.M12: Menter, Garbaruk and Egorov 2012, Progress in Flight Physics 3:89-104, doi:10.1051/eucass/201203089; archive/paper_pof/literature/pdfs/menter2012earsm.pdf; printed page numbers
sources.M09: Menter, Garbaruk and Egorov 2009, 3rd EUCASS, Versailles; archive/paper_pof/literature/pdfs/menter2009earsm.pdf; PDF page numbers (no printed numbers)
sources.reference_py: src/comparators/earsm_reference/reference.py (closed forms derived from M12 eqs. 2-8; see docstrings)

digitization: Figure values were read from the vector PDF figures rendered at 500-800 dpi, with axis ticks located in pixels (scratch scripts, not committed); uncertainty quoted per value is the line half-width plus one pixel.

preflight_gates.source: M12 Fig. 3b, p. 97 (same figure: M09 Fig. 3, PDF p. 7); text M12 pp. 96-97
preflight_gates.published_conditions: fully developed square duct, DNS conditions of Huser and Biringen (1993); Reynolds number based on mean friction velocity and half-width printed as 6000 (M12 p. 96); one quadrant, symmetry at y = z = h, streamwise periodic, 51 x 51 cross-plane grid with y+, z+ <= 0.3 (M12 p. 96)
preflight_gates.quantity: minimum over the corner bisector y = z of v/U_bulk, v the velocity normal to the lower wall (negative = towards the wall, i.e. into the corner)

same_figure_other_curves.S-BSL-EARSM: coincides with BSL-EARSM within line width
same_figure_other_curves.SST: v identically 0 (no secondary flow, M12 p. 97)

acceptance_at_published_conditions.tolerance_note: 20 percent on the magnitude (grid, code and digitization), 0.05 on the location

acceptance_at_repo_ducts.applies_to: the repository's square ducts (Re_b 1100-3500, lower than the published case); the published magnitude is not transferable, so this is a sign-and-order gate
acceptance_at_repo_ducts.require: v < 0 along the bisector over 0.03 < y/(2h) < 0.4 (flow into the corner), SST |v|/U_b < 1e-6, EARSM peak |v|/U_b between 0.004 and 0.02, peak location 0.05 <= y/(2h) <= 0.25
acceptance_at_repo_ducts.status: extrapolated from the published case; flag, do not over-interpret

preflight_gates.source: M12 p. 93 (A1 = 1.245 'allows matching the logarithmic wall layer without changing the EARSM stress-strain relationship'); M12 pp. 94-95 (equilibrium relation -uv = sqrt(cmu) k, cmu = 0.09); M12 Fig. 1b, p. 95 (u+ follows the Wieghardt-Tillmann log law)

cmu_eff_at_P_over_eps_1.sensitivity: cmu_eff depends on the local P/eps: 0.0975 at P/eps = 0.95, 0.0934 at 1.00, 0.0895 at 1.05 (closed form); -uv/k does not (0.3044, 0.3056, 0.3066), so -uv/k is the gate and cmu_eff is supporting

kappa_from_log_fit.fit_range: u+ against ln y+ over 50 <= y+ <= 0.15 delta+ (TMR plate at x = 0.97 or a channel)

normal_anisotropy_log_layer.note: closed form at P/eps = 1 (simple shear); a33 = 0 and a11 = -a22 are properties of the printed model (beta3 ~ IV = 0 in 2D), not of the data

preflight_gates.status: gate on -uv/k (insensitive to the local P/eps); cmu_eff, normal anisotropy and the kappa fit as supporting evidence
preflight_gates.procedure: TMR plate at x = 0.97 (or a channel): take the cells with 50 <= y+ <= 0.1 delta+; per cell form R = (2/3) k I - nut twoSymm(grad U) + nonlinearStress; gate: median of -R_xy/k in [0.29, 0.32]; supporting: median nut*0.09*omega/k (= cmu_eff, limiter inactive there) in [0.085, 0.100], median a_xx = R_xx/k - 2/3 within 0.03 of 0.252, a_zz within 0.03 of 0; in-situ consistency: compare_cpp-style recomputation of nut and nonlinearStress from the cell's grad U, k, omega, nu with reference.earsm_state (relative difference < 1e-6, written-precision limited)

sst_reference_cf.source: TMR FUN3D incompressible SST/SST-V, finest grid (FlatPlate_validation_cf_incomp_results_sstv.dat)

evidence: M12 Fig. 1a, p. 95: the BSL-EARSM and S-BSL-EARSM curves lie above the SST curve by 6.9e-5 in cf (+2.4 percent) at Re_x = 3.5e6 and 4.0e6 and by +2.4 percent at 6e6 (pixel centres of the separated line runs; +-0.7 percent from line width); curves merge at the plot resolution near Re_x = 1e7
analysis: log-layer -uv/k = 0.3056 > 0.3 gives kappa_eff = 0.421 > 0.41 (reference.log_layer_kappa), a lower log-law velocity at the edge and hence a higher cf, consistent in sign with the figure
tmr_flat_plate_cf.context: the protection allowance on the plate wall friction in the paper's rule is 2.1 percent (FORGE_PoF/evidence/comparator_results.json, protected/plate_friction/allowance_percent); a faithful BSL-EARSM is expected to sit near or just above that allowance on the plate. M12's SST is the ANSYS CFX implementation, not OpenFOAM v2312.

homogeneous_shear_equilibrium.source: reference.homogeneous_shear_pk_over_eps and shear_equilibrium_closed_form (M12 p. 93 omega equation without diffusion; M12 eqs. 2-8)
homogeneous_shear_equilibrium.note: M12 and M09 tabulate no homogeneous-shear anisotropy; these are the printed model's values

weak_strain_limit.note: linear eddy-viscosity model in the free stream; with tau = 1/(0.09 omega) this is nut = 3.84 k/omega, so free-stream nut is about 3.8 times the SST value k/omega for the same k and omega

unit_comparison_tolerances.note: 1e-9 covers the printed cbrt(P1 - sqrt P2) cancellation (up to 2e-11 relative in N) and double-precision field arithmetic
